section.para: In this lesson, you will write, solve, and graph linear inequalities in two variables.
When you finish this lesson, you will be able to:

list.item: Determine which side of the line the solutions to the inequality will fall, given a two-variable inequality and the graph of the related equation.
Describe the graph that represents the solutions to a linear inequality in two variables.
